about_the_game:
Floramino is a cozy puzzle game where you manage a garden! Carefully - and quickly! - arrange seeds in a compact plot to hand out flowers to patrons, keeping the spirit of Spring going!

Using planning and foresight, rotate blocky seeds into your garden to fulfill requests and grow your reputation. But beware! Weeds will rapidly infest your garden, and your shears sure aren't small enough to whack just them...

Modes

Campaign - Travel 5 biomes and bring Springtime to the far reaches of the world! In a roguelite mode, gather various tools to aid you in your travels as you meet friendly faces from every which way and fulfill your family's legacy.

Endless - Pick a ruleset that works for you and go for the biggest numbers! How long do you want to go for, or how high can you get? Find out in Endless mode!

Timed - How high can you score in the time trials? Speed is top class here!
